_comment: Tests Sports Therapy by Andy's mandatory duration question before routing, dry needling redirect to massage, and confirmation that no new/existing gate exists for this single-service clinic.

scenarios.name: Generic massage request — must ask duration before routing

history.content: I'd like to book a sports massage with Andy.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks 'Would you prefer 60 or 90 minutes, or would you like to start with a free 15-minute consultation?' as a spoken-only turn. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service without asking duration, or asks a new/existing gate question.

scenarios.name: Dry needling request — must redirect to massage, not route as separate service

history.content: I'd like to book a dry needling session.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the redirect ('Dry needling is something Andy incorporates into his massage sessions -- would you like to book one?') and waits for a reply. FAIL if agent routes to any confirm_service call, says dry needling is not offered, or asks duration before the redirect.

scenarios.name: Caller states duration upfront — routes directly after duration captured

history.content: I'd like to book a 60-minute sports massage with Andy.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. "One moment."), then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with appointment_type_id='1222086493015644829', appointment_type='Sports Massage Therapy', variant_type='smt_60' -- per CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE. FAIL if agent asks the duration question again when it was already stated, speaks more than the single filler phrase, or is fully silent (no filler at all).

scenarios.name: Availability check tonight — must ask duration, not confirm intent

history.content: Do you have an appointment tonight?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent asks the duration question: "Would you prefer 60 or 90 minutes, or would you like to start with a free 15-minute consultation?" as a spoken-only turn (no tool call). FAIL if agent says "Would you like to book?", confirms intent, or calls any tool without first asking duration.

scenarios.name: Duration answer triggers filler + confirm_service (60 min)

history.content: I'd like to book a sports massage

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent speaks EXACTLY one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. "One moment.") and nothing else -- no acknowledgement of the duration, no preview of the booking -- then calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type_id="1222086493015644829", appointment_type="Sports Massage Therapy", variant_type="smt_60". PASS requires both the single filler phrase AND the correct tool call in the same turn; a fully silent response (no filler) is a FAIL, and more than one sentence of spoken text is also a FAIL.

scenarios.name: Consultation branch triggers filler + confirm_service

history.content: Can I book the free 15 minute consultation?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent speaks EXACTLY one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set and nothing else, then calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type_id="1222465295977814776", variant_type="consultation". A fully silent response (no filler) is a FAIL.

scenarios.name: CONCERN-GUIDED empathetic line replaces filler, not both

history.content: My shoulder's been really sore, I need a massage
That's no good, let's get that sorted. Would you prefer 60 or 90 minutes, or would you like to start with a free 15-minute consultation?

scenarios.expected_behavior: No new symptom language appears in the caller's duration answer itself (the empathetic line already happened on the prior duration-question turn), so this turn is the standard filler case: agent speaks EXACTLY one filler phrase (e.g. "One moment.") and nothing else, then calls universal_router intent="confirm_service" with payload appointment_type_id="1222150508924377780", variant_type="smt_90". FAIL if the agent repeats an empathetic line here, FAIL if both a filler AND an empathetic line are spoken, FAIL if fully silent.
